svg.text: GHOSTED: Gary the pigeon postman, model sheet v1 (Illustrator, 2026-11-26)
Upright, neutral, symmetric turnaround (rest: wings folded, bag on). Body map v1. Direction A (round postie). Palette rows only.
22 #2B1E16 ink: outline, eyes, brows, brim, envelope flap line
23 #FFF8EE envelope, cap badge, cere, eye glint
- Toy pigeon: a round head on a tilted egg body,
a flat tail fan, 0.5 x Kit standing (cap in).
- Face: 2 ink eyes + glint, small brows, a gold
cone beak with a cream cere. No mouth, ever.
- Kepi: navy, set back on the crown, tilted back;
ink brim, cream badge. Never over the eyes.
- Wings: blue 9, two rigid segments + 3 finger
feathers; the fingers hold the envelope.
- Satchel: wood, his left belly front; one strap
- Envelope: cream card, ink V flap, red stamp.
FLIGHT: the 0.6 s flap loop (3 keys: up, level, down), legs tucked, body pitched 10 deg nose down, letter in the beak. View: yaw 20, pitch 25.
DELIVERY BEATS (yaw 20, pitch 25): fly in, land hop, hold out the letter, then a NO (sorry tilt) or a YES (happy hop), fly off
64 px SILHOUETTES (front, 3/4, side, flight; 1x and x4)
LINEUPS AT THE GAME CAMERA (x2): Gary standing next to Kit and Gary flying (0.9 m up), on the real Panel v1 renders (Kit, the Panel; on the path also Juno, Dot, Brett, Ricky, Ghosties, ATS).
Top: grass colour, grass grey. Bottom: path colour, path grey (Lena's formula).
body 8 vs grass 1: 1.11:1; vs path 3: 1.24:1 (low: the ink outline and the dark parts carry him)
wings 9 vs grass: 3.42:1; vs path: 3.83:1; vs body 8: 3.08:1. Cap 26 vs body 8: 5.90:1
bag 5 vs grass: 4.52:1; vs body 8: 4.07:1. Beak 13 vs body 8: 1.03:1 (shape, not value). Envelope 23 vs wing 9: 5.29:1
body 8 vs ATS robot 18: 1.57:1 (lighter, and round, not boxes); vs Ghostie 16: 1.65:1
GAME CAMERA NEXT TO KIT (x3): rest, hold out, sorry, happy hop, flight; grass then path. 1x at the right.
SIZE: 35 x 26 px standing at 1x (Kit 75 px) = 0.49 m to the cap top.
Wingspan 1.03 m = 1.06 x Kit. 1 u = 2.29 mm.
Eyes clear: lowest cap pixel 2.6 px above the eye top at rest, 2.4 px in the sorry tilt. Beak 3 x 6 px.
